purpose: Design-only successor to R1. It adds a matched control and resolves R1 review findings without editing R1. This document itself grants no authority for implementation, training, inference, cache generation, remote work, admission, or publication, and does not revoke the separate user-authorized bounded capability preparation.
question: Conditional on the same fold-clean propensity/teacher graph and warm parent, does final-member teacher supervision (main prediction distillation plus the declared family-head loss) improve the fixed three-member blend over the same three final architectures trained with exact zero final-stage teacher-loss scaling?
estimand: Equal-weight mean over F0-F3 of the within-fold mean across the frozen 8/8/7/7 paired seeds of global_wp_clip2_v1(candidate fixed blend minus matched-control fixed blend). This tests the joint final-stage teacher-supervision bundle conditional on one shared fixed-role graph per fold, not upstream KD mechanisms or teacher-refit variability.

architecture.adapter_proposal: Reuse the archived architecture specification: shared MLP Linear(104,128)->GELU->Linear(128,64)->GELU over each 52-channel instrument block concatenated with its row-to-row delta; zero-initialized Linear(128,256) residual over the two instrument embeddings; one-direction lead uses the same shared encoder on the second instrument block concatenated with its delta from the most recent first-instrument event; zero-initialized Linear(64,256) residual.

cache_contract.construction: Use only predictions from the clean fold graph, on its exact fit rows, with source model/checkpoint/SHA, preprocessing, ordered group, component, data and split identities recorded. Each source and composite must have identical row-group order before arithmetic.

main_teacher_source_variant.origin: Archived producer procedure in the pinned W18 history trace; recipe keeps the recorded direct sum but regenerates all inputs cleanly.

cache_contract.propensity_cache: Produce separate train/fit.valid row-bound caches from the clean propensity endpoint. No evaluation rows are used to fit the model or any cache values used as training targets.
cache_contract.provenance_status: The six-source coefficient formula and source scale are recorded by archived preparation code. This four-tag assignment is the present design’s explicit canonical mapping; the available history does not prove that these were the historical cache family tags or actual target-array producers.
cache_contract.target_cache_validation: Require split/source/checkpoint hashes, source row digests, same row alignment across every source, finite FP32 arrays, and create-only output names; export family head is training-only and must emit only the two main prediction columns.

feature_contract.base: 211 causal channels: 112 raw plus 99 event features in canonical order.
feature_contract.tiedlead: 263 = the 211-channel base plus 52 lead channels; implement the exact shared lead semantics described below in a reviewed focused canonical adapter. No generic 263-wide GRU may be called equivalent.
feature_contract.transform_rules: Fit-only canonical two-batch normalization for scratch roots/students; exact clean parent buffers inherited for initialized fine-tunes/final distilled student. Hash the ordered normalization membership and saved buffers.

final_bundle.blend_operation: On exactly identical ordered eval rows, compute FP32 0.34*p_distilled + 0.33*p_tlead_A + 0.33*p_tlead_B in that order. Do not optimize, calibrate, or retune coefficients.

teacher_graph_sharing.consequence: This is a declared variance-reduction/compute-sharing choice. Report seed variability conditional on fixed ancestry, and do not generalize it as full teacher-recipe variance.
teacher_graph_sharing.policy: Build one clean teacher/propensity DAG per outer fold using the role seeds below; reuse that fold-specific graph/caches for its 8 or 7 final seed cells.

pre_admission_gates: Implement and independently review the strict-FP32 propensity adapter; prove exact canonical split and fit-only normalization/cache membership.

Implement and independently review the focused canonical tiedlead adapter against the pinned source-snapshot semantics, feature ordering, causal lead selection, zero initialization, and exporter behavior.

Freeze exact per-fold manifest/data/source hashes, row membership, every stage config, cache coefficient/family map, seed map, output names and comparator mapping in a real preregistration before candidate evaluation outcomes.
Rebuild every learned ancestor and cache from clean sources for each outer fold. Do not reuse any production checkpoint, production cache or warm-start ancestor with F0-exposed membership.
Include orgbase as the explicit samefold_baseline source; do not drop it to avoid unresolved historical family assignment.
Require all cells’ paired arm execution to match provider/runtime; root must separately check campaign ownership and resource authority before any eventual admission.
Check exact update accounting and warning/OOM disposition. Preserve every failed attempt; no silently retried/skipped update counts.

shared_graph_and_initializers.graph: Construct one clean 15-node graph per outer fold and share its weights, caches and normalization artifacts across both arms and all that fold’s seed cells.
shared_graph_and_initializers.distilled_member: Both arms warm-start from that fold’s same clean fbc1k_s5@fixed_epoch3 checkpoint and preprocessing.
shared_graph_and_initializers.tiedlead_members: Both arms initialize from scratch under the same per-pair member seed and must have identical pre-update state and fit-only normalization hashes.
shared_graph_and_initializers.limitation: fbc1k_s5 is itself distilled from clean fin256 teachers. That upstream distillation remains in both arms; R2 disables only final-member teacher losses.

zero_scaling_contract.main: Alpha zero must take the canonical labels-only WMSE objective exactly; do not compute 0×teacher_loss, since that can propagate NaN/Inf and obscure the control semantics.
zero_scaling_contract.family: Weight zero skips family-loss contribution/gradient while preserving the exact same auxiliary head module, initialization, parameter ordering and checkpoint/export topology as the candidate distilled member.
zero_scaling_contract.target_cache: Generate and validate candidate teacher/family caches once per fold with the common clean graph and row/source/hash checks. The control objective must not consume teacher values or family labels; common cache integrity checks still run.
capability_review_required_before_prereg: Synthetic fixed-batch test: alpha=0 scalar loss and parameter gradients equal the labels-only objective from identical model state.
Synthetic test: family weight zero yields zero family-head gradient while head tensors remain present and shape-identical; no architecture pruning or changed inference output.
Pair check: candidate/control initial parameter and normalization hashes, sampler order, update count and fixed checkpoint identity agree before training.
Independent adapter review: family-head layout, zero-alpha branch, finite/row-bound cache checks, tiedlead causal semantics and export shape.
zero_scaling_contract.status: pending; no implementation or tests are created by this design packet

comparison_protocol.primary_treatment: Candidate: distilled alpha 0.7 and family-loss weight 1.0; each tiedlead alpha 0.5. Control: alpha 0 and family-loss weight 0 for all final members. Everything else in both arms is locked to the copied candidate recipe.
comparison_protocol.interpretation: Effect of the joint final-stage teacher-supervision bundle (main prediction targets and the distilled member’s family head) conditional on the clean shared graph and warm parent. Not every upstream distillation mechanism, not a full-pipeline comparison against labels-only cold training, and not an exact TL3 reproduction.
comparison_protocol.provider_runtime: For each (fold, seed) pair, candidate/control must use the same provider and exact pinned software/runtime. Route is bound before outcomes. Any mismatch leaves that pair incomplete.

fixed_blend.operation: FP32 0.34*p_distilled + 0.33*p_tlead_A + 0.33*p_tlead_B on identical ordered evaluation rows; no learned blend, calibration or retuning.

comparison_protocol.primary_outcome: Official global_wp_clip2_v1 for each arm’s fixed blend on that fold’s complete canonical evaluation membership.

uncertainty.seed: 10,000 paired bootstrap draws over shared seed identities, joint across arms/folds, renormalized over each fold’s available cells; conditional on fixed graph and exposed folds.
uncertainty.evaluation_units: Whole-component paired bootstrap within fold on fixed predictions, identical component multiplicities across arms; reports evaluation-unit variability conditional on fitted models, not training variability.
uncertainty.reporting: Show every one of 30 pairs and all four fold means/ranges; keep seed and component intervals separate.

effect_threshold.status: proposal only; root must freeze or replace in dated preregistration before any R2 outcome is read
effect_threshold.provenance: R1 labels this borrowed threshold as not prospectively frozen for the TL3 design.

rank1_historical_anchor.role: descriptive historical anchor only; never the primary matched control, never substitutes for an R2 pair, and never supplies a reason to retune the fixed blend

completeness_rule.complete: Only all 30 valid pairs may be called complete CP30. Any missing, invalid, unresolved or provider/runtime-mismatched pair means incomplete.
completeness_rule.partial: Partial outcomes are descriptive only, not CP30 and not grounds to promote/reject the mechanism.
completeness_rule.no_opportunistic_exclusions: No post-outcome exclusions, seed replacement, fold dropping, member substitution or route substitution. Preserve failed attempts. A repair policy must be frozen before outcomes, target the same pair identity, and retain every attempt.
completeness_rule.exposure: Complete CP30 is still exposed-panel robustness/development evidence, not untouched confirmation.
valid_pair_requirements: both arm outputs are finite, source-bound, and evaluated on the exact same complete ordered fold membership
candidate and control use the same bound provider/runtime for that pair
all three paired members preserve the specified seeds, initial-state and normalization hashes, planned successful-update counts, schedules, fixed checkpoint epochs, and expected output shapes

any unresolved or mismatched update/skip count, source identity, or checkpoint selection leaves the pair invalid and CP30 incomplete; preserve the failed attempt and do not exclude or replace the pair

cp30_design.arithmetic: 15 shared graph nodes × 4 folds = 60 fits; 30 pairs × 2 arms × 3 final members = 180 final-member fits.
cp30_design.incremental_vs_R1_candidate_only: 90 additional final-member fits for the matched control; graph remains shared, not duplicated per arm.
cp30_design.cost_note: No runtime/throughput estimate. Record actual wall time, successful and skipped updates, memory, and compute; rank-1 descriptive anchor is not an R2 fit.

split_and_component_accounting.fit_semantics: train+valid = that fold’s fit.train ∪ fit.valid only; valid-only = that fold’s fit.valid only. Exclude every fold’s full evaluation membership and associated connected components from its learned propensity, normalizers, ancestors, caches, students and checkpoint selection.

F0.note: 468 ordered F0 evaluation entries/row-groups map to 141 connected components; 468 is not the component count. Exclude all 468 and all 141 components from every F0 fitted ancestor, cache, normalizer and final member.

known_gaps: Historical creative prop_f0 producer/source/fit and normalization provenance remains unresolved, limiting exact historical attribution. Recovery of that old artifact is not required for this modified design: fit a new clean propensity per fold and bind its actual source/code, data, split, fit membership, normalization and runtime.

Historical W18 target-cache producer, ordered row identities and preprocessing provenance remain unresolved, limiting exact TL3 attribution. This is not a gate if replacement candidate caches are regenerated from the clean per-fold graph and each new cache is source-bound to its parent checkpoints, exact ordered fit rows/components, data, preprocessing, transform and code.

Canonical tiedlead adapter is not implemented/reviewed; feature order, causal lead semantics, initialization, same-topology auxiliary family head, zero-alpha objective, checkpoint and export behavior remain capability gates.
F2 exact manifest and counts are not pinned in the cited local evidence; this blocks preregistration.
All four folds’ exact current source/data/runtime bindings, the practical effect rule and complete implementation must be frozen prospectively before any outcome.
